description: Command injection vulnerability in PAN-OS GlobalProtect feature enabling unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges.
Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (MonikerLink bug) allowing NTLM credential leaking and code execution via crafted hyperlinks.
Windows TCP/IP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability triggered by sending crafted IPv6 packets to an affected system.
HTTP/2 Rapid Reset protocol flaw allowing coordinated stream cancellations resulting in massive Denial of Service against web infrastructure.
PHP CGI Argument Injection vulnerability on Windows allowing remote code execution via best-fit character encoding bypass.
OpenSSH signal handler race condition in sshd on glibc-based Linux systems allowing potential unauthenticated root execution.
MOVEit Transfer SQL injection flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to obtain unauthorized database access and execute arbitrary payloads.
FortiOS out-of-bounds write vulnerability in SSL VPN web portal permitting unauthenticated remote execution via crafted HTTP requests.
Jenkins CLI arbitrary file read vulnerability via args4j parser feature enabling remote attackers to read server files and forge session tokens.
ConnectWise ScreenConnect authentication bypass via path traversal permitting attackers to create unauthorized administrative accounts.
Citrix ADC / Gateway buffer overflow vulnerability allowing sensitive memory leakage and unauthenticated session token hijacking.
JetBrains TeamCity authentication bypass allowing remote administrative takeovers through alternative path manipulation in web interface.
